title: Select canonical guidance for an authoring activity
description: Identify and present the canonical authoring sources applicable to an activity and declared profile version, preserving the same engineering meaning for human and agent use. Selection explains applicability; it does not interpret or migrate the model itself.
inputs: Requested authoring activity and participant context.
Declared method/profile version and available canonical guidance with its owning sources.
preconditions: The activity and selected profile are supplied or their absence can be reported.
outputs: Applicable guidance owners and source versions, with rationale and worked-example navigation.
Explicit unavailable, superseded, incompatible, or ambiguous guidance context.
behavior: Match the declared activity and profile with their canonical guidance owners.
Present concepts, methods, required rules, and illustrative examples with their roles distinguished.
Preserve normative meaning across human and agent presentations, identifying source versions.
Disclose guidance that is unavailable or no longer applicable after a profile change; do not silently choose an incompatible substitute.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested activity or profile version is unknown.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the missing selection and do not claim that guidance is applicable.

failure_behavior.condition: Canonical guidance is missing or conflicting.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify affected owners and the unresolved conflict without inventing a new authoritative rule.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: SR-032 requires identifiable canonical guidance and version applicability for human and agent authors.
